The published-rule fall-through: apps/storytime/lib/content.ts:130 to 133 build a judged copy whose meta.status is published when showDraftWeeks() is true and the loaded week is not published. Line 134 runs readinessBlocker on the judged copy, so a missing page picture still blocks and media that is not approved still needs showDraftMedia() at line 142. With the switch off the review flag is false and the judged copy is the loaded week, so the path is the old one.

highestOpenWeeks applies the same rule with no log: apps/storytime/lib/content.ts:179 to 183 build the same judged copy and line 184 runs readinessBlocker on it. The function holds no console.warn call.
